sample_unit: tasks (agent runs: 90, 180, 120, 288 and 324 across four evidence regimes)

links.outcome: LLM rubric score for CDISC pipeline artifacts with curated routed context versus prompt-only
links.effect: Routed context scored 4.63 versus 4.20 for prompt-only (difference 0.43 on 1-5 scale; 95% CI 0.25-0.63; Holm-adjusted P=.01), but did not exceed flat or random loading.
